title: Aromatic metabolites regulate prodigiosin production in Serratia marcescens through SlyA.
authors: Tavares-Carreon, Faviola; Lopez de Los Santos, Yossef; Trejo, Bryant U; Flores-Maldonado, Orlando; Becerril-Garcia, Miguel A; Trevino-Rangel, Rogelio J; Andrade, Angel
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究芳香代谢物与MarR家族转录调控因子SlyA的结合，并验证其对靶基因启动子结合的影响，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系，但对象非典型TF-DNA且互作机制深度有限。
abstract: Some Serratia marcescens (Sm) strains produce the red pigment prodigiosin, which exhibits immunosuppressive, antimicrobial, and antitumoral properties. Prodigiosin biosynthesis is controlled by a complex regulatory network that includes SlyA, a MarR-family transcriptional regulator. However, the molecular mechanism by which SlyA regulates prodigiosin production remains largely unknown. Here, we showed that methyl benzoate, paeonol, salicylic acid, and p-coumaric acid reduce pigment production in Sm. Given previous evidence that small aromatic molecules can allosterically regulate MarR-family proteins, we generated a homodimeric structural model of Sm SlyA. Molecular docking analyses suggested that these aromatic metabolites bind within the two cavities of the SlyA homodimer, and molecular dynamics simulations identified methyl benzoate as the most stable ligand. Consistently, in vitro assays showed that the binding of recombinant SlyA to the prodigiosin promoter was altered in the presence of methyl benzoate and phenolic metabolites. Finally, exogenous methyl benzoate, paeonol, and salicylic acid significantly reduced pigA-gfp transcription in Sm, and this effect became more pronounced upon expression of slyA from a multicopy plasmid. Together, these findings support a model in which SlyA functions as an allosterically regulated sensor, coupling the perception of aromatic carbonyl compounds to the control of prodigiosin biosynthesis in Sm.
abstract_zh: 部分粘质沙雷氏菌（Serratia marcescens, Sm）菌株产生红色色素灵菌红素（prodigiosin），其具有免疫抑制、抗菌和抗肿瘤特性。灵菌红素的生物合成受一个复杂的调控网络控制，其中包括MarR家族转录调控因子SlyA。然而，SlyA调控灵菌红素产生的分子机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们展示了苯甲酸甲酯、丹皮酚、水杨酸和对香豆酸能减少Sm中的色素产生。鉴于先前有证据表明小芳香分子可别构调控MarR家族蛋白，我们生成了Sm SlyA的同源二聚体结构模型。分子对接分析提示这些芳香代谢物结合在SlyA同源二聚体的两个空腔内，而分子动力学模拟确定苯甲酸甲酯为最稳定的配体。一致地，体外实验显示，在苯甲酸甲酯和酚类代谢物存在下，重组SlyA与灵菌红素启动子的结合发生改变。最后，外源添加苯甲酸甲酯、丹皮酚和水杨酸显著降低了Sm中pigA-gfp的转录，并且这种效应在多拷贝质粒表达slyA时更为明显。综合这些发现，支持一个模型，即SlyA作为别构调控的传感器，将芳香羰基化合物的感知与Sm中灵菌红素生物合成的控制相耦合。
